releases.name: 0.9.1 — no steer error after sending
releases.body:
A small fix release.

- **No more "Failed to steer pending prompt" after sending.** Annotations sent from the TUI to an idle session now go in as steering input instead of queued input. OpenCode starts either one immediately, but it briefly listed the queued message, so an Enter on the empty prompt right after sending tried to steer it and failed with HTTP 409, even though the annotations had arrived. A session that is busy still queues them behind the current turn.

## Install / update

```sh
opencode plugin update @nxxxsooo/opencode-annotate@latest
```

releases.name: v0.9.0 — input-method-safe keys
releases.body:
### Input-method-safe keys

A Chinese input method holds plain letters while it composes, so review keys such as `e`, `q` and `s`, and OpenCode's permission shortcuts, did nothing until you switched to English by hand.

- **Reviews browse in ASCII.** With [Slash Saver](https://github.com/nxxxsooo/slash-saver/releases/tag/v1.1.0) 1.1+ in `/Applications`, `/annotate` (and `agy-annotate tui`) selects Slash Saver's configured ASCII source while you browse and restores your input method when the review ends, even after a crash.
- **Comments are written in your own input method.** With the fork's `local/opencode` branch, opening a comment or edit box switches back to your writing source, and closing it returns to ASCII. The fork also binds `Ctrl+E` to edit a note.
- **Permission prompts are answered in ASCII.** While an OpenCode permission prompt is open, the plugin holds the ASCII source and restores yours once every prompt is answered. Question forms are left alone because they take typed answers.
- **New `inputSource` option.** `false` turns switching off; a path selects another helper with the same `input-source current|select|ascii` commands. Without Slash Saver nothing switches, and reviews behave as before.

## Install / update

```sh
opencode plugin update @nxxxsooo/opencode-annotate@latest
```

Then install [Slash Saver 1.1.0](https://github.com/nxxxsooo/slash-saver/releases/tag/v1.1.0) and choose an ASCII input source in its settings.

releases.name: 0.8.1 — Antigravity (AGY) support and uncompressed history
releases.body:
### Antigravity (AGY) companion support

- **`agy-annotate` CLI**: Adds `agy-annotate` binary providing `status`, `tui`, `web`, and `queue` subcommands.
- **Native lifecycle hooks**: Hooks into AGY (`SessionStart`, `PreInvocation`, `Stop`) to deliver feedback directly into the conversation turn without network listeners.
- **Decoupled bridge**: Registers and routes between both `opencode` and `agy` session targets.
- **Browser panel badges**: Companion extension indicates `[AGY]` and `[OPENCODE]` provider badges and hints.
- **Adapted TUI launcher**: Automatically resolves the local fork (`plannotator-tui-annotate`), inherits full Dracula theme via `prepareTheme()`, applies 120-column measure layout, and supports one-key return on `q` / `Ctrl+S` (`PLANNOTATOR_TUI_SEND_INTENT`).

### Performance

- Request session history uncompressed: OpenCode 2.2.0 compresses API responses at ~80 KB/s; uncompressed local pages load in milliseconds.

## Install / update

```sh
opencode plugin update @nxxxsooo/opencode-annotate@latest
```

For AGY:
```sh
npx @nxxxsooo/opencode-annotate@latest status
```

releases.name: 0.7.0 — one-key send and browser review rounds
releases.body:
### Text review

- Pass `PLANNOTATOR_TUI_SEND_INTENT` to the TUI. With the fork's `local/opencode` branch
  (proposed upstream as plannotator/plannotator-tui#109), `q` with notes returns and sends
  without the OpenCode confirmation; `Ctrl+S`, `E` and `S` send too, following `[keys]`,
  and `Ctrl+S` saves an open comment first. `Ctrl+C` returns so OpenCode asks. The header
  shows one **Send N back (q)** button; the clipboard copy and Review menu are hidden.
  Upstream binaries are unaffected.

### Browser review rounds

- Sending closes a review round: delivered notes leave the list, page markers renumber,
  and the panel is ready for the next round. **Restore last round** brings the latest
  delivered notes back; the last ten rounds per page are kept.
- Without a live session, the primary action is **Copy N notes & continue**; a copy icon
  beside Send offers the same when connected. Copying closes the round and supersedes a
  failed batch; a blocked clipboard keeps the round open.
- Copy writes the clipboard within the click, before saving an open draft, and falls back
  to the new `clipboardWrite` permission, so Chrome no longer refuses it on slow pages.
- Separate the two delivery modes: a **Live**/**Offline** marker beside the destination,
  **Send N notes** only with a live session, **Copy N notes** otherwise. A session that
  drops during Send keeps the notes and switches to Copy instead of showing an error.
- Detect a stale background worker after an update and offer **Reload Annotate**
  instead of `Unknown annotation action`.
- Strip invisible format characters from page titles, such as Feishu's title watermark.
- Reconnect page tools automatically after a reload or same-site navigation, fixing
  `Could not establish connection. Receiving end does not exist.` on Pick, Show on page
  and markers. When Chrome has withdrawn access, the panel asks for one icon click.

## Install / update

```sh
opencode plugin update @nxxxsooo/opencode-annotate@latest
```

Reload the browser extension from `browser/` to pick up the new panel.

releases.name: 0.6.0 — annotate any session text
releases.body:
### Text review

- Add `/annotate-pick` to choose among recent replies and mid-turn progress updates, and
  `/annotate-selection` to review the message containing the last transcript selection.
- Move browser review to `/annotate-web` (pairing, URL, HTML file or `off`); `/annotate`
  now handles replies and documents only. Retire numbered `/annotate N`.

### Inherited TUI colors

- Add opt-in `inheritTheme` support for the color-capable Plannotator fork, including
  the OpenCode canvas, text, Markdown, borders, selection and cursor contrast pairs.
  Inherited colors also cover strong/emphasis text, list markers, rules, link labels,
  table headers and the send button.
- Validate a private per-review configuration before suspending the terminal; preserve
  the user's layout settings, including the fork's `doc_width`, and keep the themed
  config with recoverable drafts.

### Compact browser workspace

- Replace the always-expanded browser form with a selection-focused composer, numbered
  note queue, and persistent destination/delivery bar; keep controls visible at narrow widths and zoom.
- Autosave unfinished feedback by page, recover it after navigation or panel reload, and
  protect selection changes and competing-panel edits with explicit draft choices.
- Fix cancelling and reselecting the same element, add safe Show on page and revision-aware
  deletion Undo, and keep the intended destination visible while disconnected.
- Show pending/sent counts, distinguish original-batch retries from new feedback, and move
  copy/export/context utilities into More review options. **Save note** is now **Add note**.

## Install or update

```sh
opencode plugin update @nxxxsooo/opencode-annotate@latest
```

New install: add `@nxxxsooo/opencode-annotate@latest` to `plugins` in OpenCode's `cli.json`, then reopen the terminal client.

`inheritTheme` and `[ui].doc_width` need the extended Plannotator fork ([nxxxsooo/plannotator-tui](https://github.com/nxxxsooo/plannotator-tui), branch `feat/layout`); upstream 0.9.4 keeps working without them.
